finalists.label: Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Dysplasia
finalists.why: This candidate has the most specific and decisive evidence, including an epsilon wave in V1 and a markedly dilated right ventricle with severely reduced systolic function.

finalists.label: Chronic Thromboembolic Pulmonary Hypertension
finalists.why: This candidate has some relevant evidence, including abrupt onset of dyspnea and chronic kidney disease, but it is not as strong as the evidence for Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Dysplasia.

finalists.label: Thrombophilia
finalists.why: This candidate has no evidence for or against it, making it a weak candidate.

frontier_selector.why: The epsilon wave in V1 and the markedly dilated right ventricle with severely reduced systolic function were the decisive findings that led to the selection of Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Dysplasia as the champion.
